title: F-22 Raptor Airframe
label: SOURCED
summary: Fifth-generation twin-engine air-dominance fighter airframe combining low-observable shaping, internal weapons carriage, supercruise aerodynamics, and thrust vectoring.
role: Primary structural and aerodynamic envelope integrating all major airframe sections, propulsion, avionics, and internal payload bays.
materials: Approximately 39% titanium alloys, 24% carbon-fiber composites (24–35% across production summaries), 16% aluminum alloys, and ~1% thermoplastics by structural weight.
